name: App Updates
description: One list of updates for your apps: App Store, Homebrew and apps' own updaters.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Checks every app on your Mac for a newer version and lists them in one place, whether they come from the App Store, Homebrew or their own updater.
rules: Press Check to look online; nothing is checked until you ask.
Homebrew apps update right there; App Store apps open their page, and other apps open so their own updater can run.
